title: A robust XOR lemma for decision trees under log-concave correlation bounds

standard_prerequisites.name: Decision trees, conditional expectation and product distributions
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Author Definitions 2.1, 2.4, 2.5; necessary definitions and full author Claim3.3 retained.

core_obligations: Prove the author Q-fair decision-tree XOR bound by induction, including conditional subtrees.
Round blockwise query budgets to produce a bounded family of admissible tuples.
Use log-concavity and a stars-and-bars bound to obtain exponentially amplified correlation.
difficulty_reason: The author introduces input-dependent Q-fair query budgets, controls their correlation by a subtree induction, and combines rounded budgets with a log-concavity argument. This is a nonroutine hardness-amplification mechanism; supporting claims remain uncounted.
